title: Just ok
text:
I got my first box at a discounted rate, but canceled my subscription after because I don’t feel that it’s worth the full price of $30.

I was expecting 3 crafts, and I got 7—so that was good. However, I am only impressed with 3 of the crafts. The other 4 are very basic (a coloring sheet, 2 sheets of blank paper with minimal instructions (“draw a sea animal”), and a tiny pirate ship cutout to color).

I also like that you can make 2 of each craft. But I will only purchase this again if I know in advance what I’m getting and feel like it’s a good value.
label: neutral
